ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx 95% of visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized spots and peripheral barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across the primary fluke body; isolated high-intensity circular clusters scattered across both lobes, with higher concentration near terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 120 degrees; moderate depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire continuous trailing edge; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 5-15 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups located on the distal tips of both lobes and sparse distributions on the ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization or parasitic scarring on the extreme tips of both lobes, resulting in irregular, high-contrast bulbous extensions.
